paragraphs: VETRO sells cloud software for mapping fiber networks, built to plan, design, build and operate them. The buyers it addresses are network operators building connectivity. A separate package lets engineering firms share network plans on one platform for client feedback.

Design work happens at strand level, with precise equipment connections for accuracy. Automation identifies routes between A and Z points, estimates costs, handles splicing and validates paths. Field crews capture data in any location through an offline mode. Map layers can include ESRI map services or the Ordnance Survey basemap.

Case studies name CCI Systems designing a fiber network in rural Oregon after a wildfire. Another names Ascend Broadband using the platform as a central operational hub. A customer quote on the products page is attributed to Greenlight Networks in New York. One customer says an ARPA grant application was put together in nine days.

quote.text: cloud-native fiber management platform built to plan, design, build and operate your network
